items: A log whose pyre version you can burn
Coins for building materials, or 18000 if you want to buy a Flamtaer hammer (5000)
rec: A Mort'ton teleport or Barrows teleport tablet
rewards: Ability to play the Shades of Mort'ton Minigame

st.t: Search the shelf in the south building of Mort'ton.
Read the diary.
Add ashes to both tarromin potions (unf) to make 2 serum 207. You'll need the second one later.

i: A log whose pyre version you can burn
Coins for building materials, or 18000 if you want to buy a Flamtaer hammer (5000)

st.t: Use the serum 207 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Talk to Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
s: What are all these shadowy creatures?
Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.

st.t: Kill 5 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Use the serum 207 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Talk to Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.

i: A log whose pyre version you can burn
Coins for building materials, or 18000 if you want to buy a Flamtaer hammer (5000)

st.t: Talk to Razmire in the north of Mort'ton and buy some olive oil from his general store.
s: Can you open a store for me?
Can I see the general store please?

st.t: Talk to Razmire again and buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks and 25 swamp paste from his builders' store.
s: Can you open a store for me?
Can I see the building store please?

st.t: Use some serum 207 on Ulsquire, in the house just south-east of Razmire's store in the east of Mort'ton.
Talk to Ulsquire in the east of Mort'ton.
Talk to Ulsquire again.
s: What can you tell me about that temple?

st.t: Repair the walls of the temple north east of Mort'ton with your hammer and materials until it's 100% repaired. Do this on World 377 to make it faster and easier.
Light the fire altar
Keep repairing the temple until 20 sanctity.
Use the olive oil on the temple's fire.
Use a serum 207 (with 2 or more doses) on the temple's fire.
Use the sacred oil on a log.
i: A log whose pyre version you can burn

st.t: Go to a group of 4 stone funeral pyres, shown as brown patches on the map, for example west of the general store. Use the pyre log on a funeral pyre, then a loar remain, and light it. Collect your reward from the stone pillar next to the pyre.
i: A pyre log you can burn

st.t: Use the serum 208 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Use some serum 208 on Ulsquire in the east of Mort'ton.
Talk to Ulsquire to finish the quest.

i: A log whose pyre version you can burn
Coins for building materials, or 18000 if you want to buy a Flamtaer hammer (5000)
